# What does this PR do?
Unit tests in CI have intermittent hangs, most notably in the GDN unit tests, but also in other test suites more rarely.

This is due to [pytorch#200848](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/200848). torch >= 2.10 forks worker processes, and locks break under forking in Python < 3.12.8 or Python 3.13.0.

The fix is setting `TORCHINDUCTOR_QUIESCE_ASYNC_COMPILE_POOL=0`. This PR does that, and also undoes various previous patches meant to work around this issue.

Related: #7742 #8120 #8148 #8310 #5476 #5473

# What does this PR do?
Unit tests in CI have intermittent hangs, most notably in the GDN unit tests, but also in other test suites more rarely.

This is due to [pytorch#200848](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/200848). torch >= 2.10 forks worker processes, and locks break under forking in Python < 3.12.8 or Python 3.13.0.

The fix is setting `TORCHINDUCTOR_QUIESCE_ASYNC_COMPILE_POOL=0`. This PR does that, and also undoes various previous patches meant to work around this issue.

detail.title: Fix torch Inductor race condition in tests

files.patch:
@@ -1,3 +1,14 @@
-import torch._dynamo
+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+import os
+import sys
+
+# Inductor's Triton compile sidecar re-forks its worker pool after an idle quiesce; a worker
+# forked mid-shutdown can inherit a held lock and never return its job, hanging the rank in
+# async_compile.wait (pytorch/pytorch#200848). CPython fixed the lock in 3.12.8 and 3.13.1.
+if sys.version_info < (3, 12, 8) or sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 13, 0):
+    os.environ.setdefault("TORCHINDUCTOR_QUIESCE_ASYNC_COMPILE_POOL", "0")
+
+import torch._dynamo  # after the env default: importing dynamo loads torch._inductor.config
 
 torch._dynamo.config.suppress_errors = True
